title.ja: 図1-1 対振り飛車の基本形
title.en: Figure 1-1: Basic form against Ranging Rook

explain.ja: 図1-1は対振り飛車の基本形です。この形から斜め棒銀で戦う手順を解説します。
explain.en: Diagram 1-1 is the basic form against Ranging Rook. We explain the diagonal Climbing Silver plan from this form.

section.ja: 対振り飛車の基本形
section.en: Basic formation against Ranging Rook

title.ja: 図1-2 左の銀を前に出していく
title.en: Figure 1-2: Advance the left silver

explain.ja: 斜め棒銀には、左の銀を攻めに使う形と右の銀を使う形がありますが、ここでは左銀で攻める順を見ます。
explain.en: Diagonal Climbing Silver has a form using the left silver and one using the right silver; here we see the line attacking with the left silver.

section.ja: 左銀を▲6八銀~▲5七銀と前に出す
section.en: Advance the left silver forward with ▲6八銀 to ▲5七銀

line.text: △7二玉、▲9六歩、△9四歩、▲2五歩、△8二玉、▲6八銀

title.ja: 図1-3 ▲4六銀左急戦
title.en: Figure 1-3: ▲4六銀 left rapid attack

explain.ja: 左の銀をさらに前に出します。ここから▲4六銀と使って攻めるのが「▲4六銀左急戦」で、銀を4六に出して攻める順の総称が「斜め棒銀」です。斜め棒銀は、振り飛車側の銀が3二にいるか4三にいるかで攻め方が変わるので、順に見ます。
explain.en: Advance the left silver further. Attacking with ▲4六銀 from here is the ▲4六 left-silver rapid attack, and lines that attack by bringing the silver to 4六 are generally called diagonal Climbing Silver. The attack changes depending on whether the Ranging Rook side's silver is on 3二 or 4三, so we look at each.

section.ja: 左銀を▲6八銀~▲5七銀と前に出す
section.en: Advance the left silver forward with ▲6八銀 to ▲5七銀

title.ja: 図2-1 △4三銀型の振り飛車と戦う
title.en: Figure 2-1: Fight the Ranging Rook with the silver on 4三

explain.ja: まず図1-3から、△4三銀として相手が4三銀型の振り飛車に組んできたときの攻め方を見ます。
explain.en: First, from Diagram 1-3, see how to attack when the opponent builds a Ranging Rook with the silver on 4三 by △4三銀.

section.ja: △4三銀型の四間飛車に組まれたら?
section.en: What if White builds Fourth File Rook with the 4三 silver?

title.ja: 図2-2 ▲4六銀～▲3五歩として仕掛ける
title.en: Figure 2-2: Attack with ▲4六銀 and ▲3五歩

explain.ja: △4三銀型の振り飛車に対しては、▲4六銀と出てから▲3五歩と突いて仕掛けます。ここから△同歩、▲同銀と進めば居飛車側の攻めが好調で優勢になります。相手はこの歩を取らずに別の手を探します。基本は相手の角の頭を攻める手順です。
explain.en: Against a Ranging Rook with the silver on 4三, advance ▲4六銀 and attack with ▲3五歩. If △同歩 ▲同銀 follows, Static Rook's attack goes well and Black is better. The opponent will look for another move instead of taking the pawn. The basic plan is attacking the head of the opponent's bishop.

section.ja: ▲4六銀と出てから▲3五歩で仕掛ける
section.en: Advance ▲4六銀, then attack with ▲3五歩

title.ja: 図2-3 飛車を3筋に回すのが定跡
title.en: Figure 2-3: Swinging the rook to the 3rd file is joseki

explain.ja: 斜め棒銀の攻めに対しては、△3二飛と飛車を3筋に回して受けるのが定跡です。ここで▲3四歩と3筋の歩を取り込むことが多いですが、その前に指しておきたい手があります。
explain.en: Against the diagonal Climbing Silver attack, the standard defense is to swing the rook to the 3rd file with △3二飛. Black often takes the 3rd-file pawn with ▲3四歩 here, but there is a move to play first.

section.ja: 相手は△同歩とは取らずに、飛車を3筋に回す
section.en: The opponent does not capture with △ same pawn and swings the rook to the 3rd file

title.ja: 図2-4 2筋の歩を突き捨てておく
title.en: Figure 2-4: Sacrifice the 2nd-file pawn in advance

explain.ja: 3筋の歩を取り込む前に、2筋の歩を突き捨てておくのがポイントです。この突き捨ての意味は、もう少し手を進めるとわかります。▲2四歩に△同角なら、▲5五歩、△同歩、▲同銀と角のラインを使って攻めます。
explain.en: Before taking the 3rd-file pawn, the key is to push and sacrifice the 2nd-file pawn. Its meaning becomes clear a few moves later. If White takes ▲2四歩 with △同角, attack using the bishop line with ▲5五歩 △同歩 ▲同銀.

section.ja: 2筋を突き捨てておくのがポイント
section.en: Key point: sacrifice a pawn push on the 2nd file first

title.ja: 図2-5 3筋を争点にして戦う
title.en: Figure 2-5: Make the 3rd file the point of contention

explain.ja: 2筋の歩を突き捨てたら、いよいよ▲3四歩と取り込んで勝負をかけます。飛車も3筋に回って銀取りに当て、戦いを始めます。相手が銀を逃げれば、▲3四歩と打ち込んで攻めます。このままがりがり攻められる局面です。
explain.en: After pushing and sacrificing the 2nd-file pawn, finally take ▲3四歩 and commit. The rook also swings to the 3rd file attacking the silver, and the battle begins. If the opponent moves the silver away, Black attacks by driving in ▲3四歩. Black can keep pressing relentlessly in this position.

section.ja: 2筋を突き捨てておくのがポイント
section.en: Key point: sacrifice a pawn push on the 2nd file first

title.ja: 図2-6 △4五歩として捌きを狙うのが定跡
title.en: Figure 2-6: Aiming for a tesuji with △4五歩 is joseki

explain.ja: ここで振り飛車側が△4五歩と突くのが定跡です。角のラインを通しながら銀取りに当て、一気に大駒をさばく狙いです。
explain.en: Here the standard move for the Ranging Rook side is △4五歩. It opens the bishop's line while attacking the silver, aiming to free the major pieces at once.

section.ja: △4五歩として捌きを狙うのが定跡
section.en: Aiming to untangle with △4五歩 is joseki

title.ja: 図a-1 飛車を取られる
title.en: Figure a-1: The rook is captured

explain.ja: 図2-6から▲3四飛と銀を取りたくなりますが、これは大悪手です。△8八角成と角交換を迫りつつ王手をされ、▲同玉に△3四飛でこちらの飛車が取られてしまいます。
explain.en: From Diagram 2-6 you may want to capture the silver with ▲3四飛, but this is a big blunder. White forces a bishop exchange with check by △8八角成, and after ▲同玉, △3四飛 captures our rook.

section.ja: △4五歩として捌きを狙うのが定跡
section.en: Aiming to untangle with △4五歩 is joseki

title.ja: 図2-7 角交換して攻め合う
title.en: Figure 2-7: Exchange bishops and trade attacks

explain.ja: 図2-6から、こちらから角交換して攻め合います。角交換した後は、銀取りを無視して▲2二角と打ち込みます。相手の飛車が逃げれば▲3四飛と銀を取れます。
explain.en: From Diagram 2-6, exchange bishops yourself and race. After the exchange, ignore the threat to the silver and drop ▲2二角. If the opponent's rook runs, ▲3四飛 captures the silver.

section.ja: 大駒を一気に捌く展開に
section.en: Developing into a quick release of major pieces

title.ja: 図2-8 激しい攻め合いが続く
title.en: Figure 2-8: A fierce exchange of attacks continues

explain.ja: さらに攻め合いが続きます。図2-8まで進むと、相手は桂取りを受けるのが難しく、居飛車側がやや攻めやすくなっています。△4三金とすれば桂取りは受けられますが、あらかじめ2筋の歩を突き捨てていた効果で、▲2四飛と回って攻めが続きます。
explain.en: The race continues. By Diagram 2-8 the opponent has trouble meeting the threat to the knight and Static Rook attacks a bit more easily. △4三金 can meet the knight attack, but thanks to the earlier sacrifice of the 2nd-file pawn, ▲2四飛 swinging over keeps the attack going.

section.ja: 大駒を一気に捌く展開に
section.en: Developing into a quick release of major pieces

title.ja: 図b-1 ▲2四飛がないので攻めが止まる
title.en: Figure b-1: The attack stops without ▲2四飛

explain.ja: 図2-8で、あらかじめ2筋の歩を突き捨てていないと、△4三金で攻め手が止まります。図b-1では、▲2四飛と2筋に回って攻めを続ける手がないことがわかります。ここで2筋の歩を突き捨てた効果が出てきます。
explain.en: In Diagram 2-8, if the 2nd-file pawn had not been sacrificed beforehand, △4三金 would stop the attack. In Diagram b-1 there is no ▲2四飛 swing to continue the attack. This is where sacrificing the 2nd-file pawn pays off.

section.ja: 大駒を一気に捌く展開に
section.en: Developing into a quick release of major pieces

title.ja: 図3-1 △3二銀型の四間飛車
title.en: Figure 3-1: Fourth File Rook with the silver on 3二

explain.ja: 図1-3から、相手が3二銀型のまま駒組みを進めてきた場合を見ます。3二銀型の四間飛車への急戦策は「山田定跡」と呼ばれます。山田定跡には様々な攻め筋がありますが、ここでは斜め棒銀系の形を見ます。
explain.en: From Diagram 1-3, see the case where the opponent keeps developing with the silver on 3二. The rapid attack against a Fourth File Rook with the silver on 3二 is called Yamada Joseki. It has various attacking lines; here we look at the diagonal Climbing Silver type.

section.ja: △3二銀型の四間飛車に組まれたら?
section.en: What if White builds Fourth File Rook with the 3二 silver?

title.ja: 図3-2 3筋の歩を突き捨ててから▲4六銀
title.en: Figure 3-2: Sacrifice the 3rd-file pawn, then ▲4六銀

explain.ja: 山田定跡では、先に▲3五歩と3筋の歩を突き捨ててから▲4六銀と出るのが形です。歩を突き捨てる前に▲4六銀と出ると、△4五歩で銀を追い返されます。先に3筋の歩を突き捨てておくのを忘れないようにしましょう。
explain.en: In Yamada Joseki the form is to sacrifice the 3rd-file pawn first with ▲3五歩 and then advance ▲4六銀. If ▲4六銀 is played before sacrificing the pawn, △4五歩 drives the silver back. Don't forget to sacrifice the 3rd-file pawn first.

section.ja: ▲3五歩と突き捨ててから、▲4六銀と出る
section.en: Sacrifice ▲3五歩, then advance ▲4六銀

title.ja: 図3-3 △4五歩と突かれた場合
title.en: Figure 3-3: If White plays △4五歩

explain.ja: 図3-2から、△4五歩と突かれた場合の手順を見ます。相手はこちらの銀に当てながら角道を開けてきました。
explain.en: From Diagram 3-2, see the sequence when White pushes △4五歩. The opponent attacks our silver while opening the bishop diagonal.

section.ja: △4五歩とされた場合
section.en: If White plays △4五歩

title.ja: 図3-4 こちらから角交換する
title.en: Figure 3-4: Exchange bishops from our side

explain.ja: 相手から△8八角成、▲同玉と角交換されると、こちらの玉が囲いから離れてしまうので、こちらから角交換します。そのあとは▲3五銀と攻めます。ここから▲2四歩と攻める手もありますが、まだ難解です。
explain.en: If the opponent exchanges bishops with △8八角成 ▲同玉, our king leaves its castle, so we exchange bishops ourselves. After that attack with ▲3五銀. ▲2四歩 is also possible from here, but it is still difficult.

section.ja: △4五歩とされた場合
section.en: If White plays △4五歩

title.ja: 図3-4 △3六歩と伸ばすのが好手
title.en: Figure 3-4: △3六歩 extending is a good move

explain.ja: 図3-2から別の手順を見ます。ここから△3六歩と歩を伸ばすのが好手で、いやなところに利いていますが、こちらはこの歩を取ることがなかなかできません。
explain.en: See another line from Diagram 3-2. Extending the pawn with △3六歩 is a good move; it is annoying, yet we can hardly take the pawn.

section.ja: △3六歩と歩を伸ばすのが手筋
section.en: Extending the pawn with △3六歩 is the tesuji

title.ja: 図3-5 角の捌きを狙う
title.en: Figure 3-5: Aim to develop the bishop

explain.ja: 振り飛車側としては、やはり△4五歩と突いて捌きを狙うのが手筋です。
explain.en: For the Ranging Rook side, pushing △4五歩 and aiming to free the pieces is again the tesuji.

section.ja: △3六歩と歩を伸ばすのが手筋
section.en: Extending the pawn with △3六歩 is the tesuji

title.ja: 図3-6 まだまだ難解な局面
title.en: Figure 3-6: Still a complicated position

explain.ja: こちらから角交換するのがポイントです。相手から角交換されると、△8八角成、▲同玉で玉が囲いから離れてしまいます。ここからもまだ難しい局面が続きます。
explain.en: The key is to exchange bishops ourselves. If the opponent does so, △8八角成 ▲同玉 pulls our king out of its castle. Difficult positions still continue from here.

section.ja: △3六歩と歩を伸ばすのが手筋
section.en: Extending the pawn with △3六歩 is the tesuji

title.ja: 図c-1 鷺宮定跡
title.en: Figure c-1: Saginomiya joseki

explain.ja: ▲4六銀と銀を出る前に、先に▲3八飛と飛車を3筋に回る順もあり、これは「鷺宮定跡」と呼ばれます。鷺宮定跡も山田定跡と同じく、△3二銀型の四間飛車に使われる手順です。
explain.en: There is also a line that swings the rook to the 3rd file with ▲3八飛 before advancing ▲4六銀, called Saginomiya Joseki. Like Yamada Joseki, it is used against Fourth File Rook with the silver on 3二.

section.ja: △3六歩と歩を伸ばすのが手筋
section.en: Extending the pawn with △3六歩 is the tesuji
